actions.systemColorsHint: Restore the colors that were in place before Airo started
actions.applyNowHint: Apply this monitor's colors right now

monitors.enableHint: Turn on colour switching for this monitor
monitors.disableHint: Turn off — this monitor keeps the system colours

colors.outlineHint: COLOR_HIGHLIGHT — the line around the rectangle you drag with the mouse
colors.fillHint: COLOR_HOTLIGHT — the translucent fill inside that rectangle

preview.title: What it will look like
preview.note: Windows chooses the fill opacity itself — it is only approximated here.

autostart.title: Start with Windows
autostart.hint: Airo starts minimized and begins tracking the cursor right away

applyOnClick.title: Change colour on click
applyOnClick.hint: The colour is applied on the first mouse click after you move to another monitor. Turn this off to change it the moment the cursor crosses the boundary — more noticeable, but it forces every window to repaint on each crossing.

startHidden.title: Start minimized to tray
startHidden.hint: The window is not shown on startup

language.title: Interface language
language.hint: Applies to the window and the tray menu
